topic: Driving a paid-off car vs a perpetual car payment (Cyril vs Leona)

scenes.narration: She kept her paid off car and turned the payment into eighty grand. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a tiny car with a banner reading PAID OFF, comic burst banner reads EIGHTY GRAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cyril and Leona both finally pay off the same car.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man cyril and woman leona each beside identical cars stamped PAID OFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each had a five hundred dollar monthly car payment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both holding old loan papers stamped FIVE HUNDRED A MONTH, now marked CLEARED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cyril trades it in immediately for a shiny new loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cyril swapping his car for a shiny new one, a new loan paper stamped FIVE HUNDRED AGAIN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He restarts the five hundred payment and never escapes it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cyril on a treadmill chasing a car loan that never ends, comic banner reads FOREVER PAYMENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leona keeps her reliable paid off car and drives on.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, leona happily driving her older car stamped PAID OFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She redirects that five hundred straight into an investing account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an arrow moving FIVE HUNDRED from leona into an investing app chart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every month her old payment quietly buys index funds instead.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, leona's phone showing a rising INDEX FUND chart fed by monthly deposits, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten years later Cyril is still making car payments forever.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, weary cyril beside his car still stamped FIVE HUNDRED DUE, a calendar reading TEN YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Leona's invested payments grew to eighty thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, leona smiling beside a tall investment chart reading EIGHTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same car cost, but only Leona built real wealth.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, cyril with bills, leona with a glowing wealth chart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Keep the paid off car, invest the old payment. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
